headline: Billy never fights alone: DOUBLE DRAGON co-op ships
lede: Stage 4 of the belt-scroller commission lands — the blue seat defaults on, CPU Jimmy Lee clears goons beside you, and a second player can drop in mid-fight with WASD + F/G/V like the Contra cabinet. The whole four-stage commission (#2795) is now live at jalfern.com/retrogames/double-dragon.
notes: Seat-as-fighter refactor: both dragons run the same sim code — nearest-dragon targeting with hysteresis, dual life banks with a second-wind revive, crowd cap of three attackers (the arcade's rule), either seat can cut Marian loose.
Fixed a nasty co-op deadlock found by the soak: two dragons could pin a goon in a crate corner for 57,000 ticks. The slip step now prefers the depth axis and the brain closes on both axes.

QA's polish pass merged under the branch mid-flight; the rebase union-merged it and generalized the new juice (whip crack-flash, blade-stick beats) to both seats. ddragoncheck grew to 97 checks, all green; seven planted mutants all die named — including ally-blind (a crowd that ignores the blue seat) and seat-blind (one bank empty is a seat down, not a game over).
Contract stays honest: solo remains the sim default (?solo=1), S1–S3 fixtures unchanged, seed replay still deterministic with the CPU ally on board.
Polish backlog for the QA lane filed as #2833: Jimmy needs a personality of his own — spacing, the occasional showy spin, drifting toward his partner when the street goes quiet.
